method: Analytic STEP cylinder axes, radii and perpendicular planar faces
status: measured CAD geometry, not released manufacturing interfaces
source_notice: Vendor CAD is not redistributed. Obtain original inputs from sources/joints.json.

frame.axis_inference: axis of maximum-radius analytic cylinder; largest component made positive
frame.angle_definition: atan2(offset dot v, offset dot u), degrees in [0,360); u cross v = axis
frame.axial_coordinate_definition: dot(world point, axis); not offset to mounting face

limitations: Geometric features only; not all listed cylinders are available mounting holes.
Thread form, fit, preload, tolerances, accessibility and rotating/fixed-side ownership are not inferred.
STEP axes/origins and clocking are vendor-specific; retain the provided basis during CAD transfer.
No material densities or physical COM/inertia have been inferred from STEP volume.

unified_joint_interface.status: geometrically identified contact candidates; mounting-side choice and tolerances unapproved
unified_joint_interface.definition: +Z toward output, origin on output annular contact plane; X is projected vendor +X, or +Y when shaft is along X; Y=Z cross X.

central_clearance_boss.function: clearance boss; no h6 fit specified for this diameter

outer_output_pilot.note: Different feature from central clearance boss; straight cylinder intervals are retained in raw extraction; usable fit length requires selected mating lip and drawing review.

thread_depth_reference.reference: output annular contact plane at joint z=0
thread_depth_reference.warning: Clearance-channel and thread-start details differ in STEP; drawing notation and screw engagement must be confirmed before manufacturing. Do not equate total screw insertion with thread engagement.

unified_joint_interface.evidence: RH Series-product manual-260805.pdf page 3 and per-model 2D-A/A0 plus STEP
unresolved: Fixed flange can be approached from front or rear; no unique manufacturer-labelled datum assumed.
Output versus housing clocking is the STEP assembly state, not a verified encoder electrical zero.
Contact-face identification is geometric; flatness, finish, assembly gap and preload remain manufacturing requirements.
